product.title: Cortech Endurance X-Base Table with Round Top - Molded Base and Molded Top - Model 66749
product.body_html:
The Cortech Endurance X-Base Table, like the rest of Cortech's Endurance Series Furniture line, is ideal for continuous use in extreme environments, including compassionate and normative Behavioral Health Care Facilities, Residential Treatment Centers and Facilities, Hospital Psychiatric Units, Correctional Institutions, Mental Health Treatment Centers and other medical and public safety facilities that require the ultimate combination of durability and functional design. Cortech Endurance X-Base Tables have extreme load capacities due to rotational molding technology. Rounded table top edge increases safety and comfort, making these tables ideal for dining or recreational applications. Perfect for use with Cortech Razorback Chairs

  • Table top size: 42" or 48" round
  • Dimensions:
    • 66749 - 29"H x 42"W x 42"D
    • 66751 - 29"H x 48"W x 48"D
  • Table top and base are made with durable, one piece, rotationally molded design for increased strength. Constructed of high impact polytheylene
  • Infused with Cor-X antimicrobial compound
  • Can be bolted to the floor via concealed pilot holes with our exclusive Sabre Mount System
  • Base affixes to table top with tamper resistant screws and/or can be filled with sand to weigh down
  • Sound dampening
  • Easy to clean, sanitize, and maintain
  • Tested to ISO 22196 showing a >99% reduction in bacteria
  • Flame Retardant (passes Cal 133)
  • Colors: Aqua, Black, Blue Gray, Brown, Burgundy, Gray, Green, Indigo, Midnight Blue, Sand, Slate Blue, Stone Gray
  • Your choice of Plain Top or Game Top
  • Manufactured to ISO Quality Standards in the USA

About Cortech Endurance Furniture:
The Cortech Endurance intense use furniture line is ideal for use as behavioral health furniture, correctional facility furniture, detention furniture, and Behavioral Healthcare mental health furniture. The Endurance Furniture Series is also a perfect fit for residential institutions, public safety facilities, detention centers, correctional institutions, prisons and any intense or high abuse applications such as drug and alcohol rehabilitation centers and addiction treatment centers.

About Cortech USA:
Cortech USA (Correctional Technologies) manufactures products that are exceptionally durable, designed for use in compassionate and normative behavioral healthcare, corrections, law enforcement, heavy use commercial and industrial environments, parks and recreation, schools, universities, hospitals, emergency and homeless shelters, and other institutions and facilities where safety and durability matter. Cortech products are ideal for extreme use and intensive use environments.
